Rosas — Madrid, Spain

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Las Rosas has genuine, repeated recent coverage: a documented 'aumento de los robos' (robbery increase) with residents 'indignados' as of roughly a month before an August 2026 report, a narcopiso dismantled directly across from a local adult-education centre in February 2026, a report headlined 'Suciedad, drogas y peleas' (dirt, drugs and fights) describing residents' complaints, over ten years of a resident living alongside a narcopiso, and an August 2026 squatting incident in which a hospitalised woman's home was occupied by intruders. Sources checked: Facebook/C9N Paraguay (robbery increase, ~Jul 2026); Telemadrid, 26 Feb 2026 (narcopiso dismantled); Telemadrid, 21 Jun 2026 ('Suciedad, drogas y peleas'); Telemadrid, Oct 2025 ('Mas de 10 anos conviviendo con un narcopiso'); ABC, 19 Aug 2026 (squatting incident).
